long.title: Petra: The Lost Rose-Red City Hidden in the Desert | Ancient Wonders
long.description:
Hidden deep in the Jordanian desert stands a city carved straight into rose-red cliffs — Petra, the lost capital of the Nabataeans. For nearly two thousand years its secrets stayed buried in the sand. This is the epic true story of how desert nomads built one of the richest cities on Earth, and how it vanished.
